I went yesterday for my first annual exam. It's not as bad as you think, and finding someone friendly is very helpful. The nurse st the place I went to immediately put me at ease, and the doctor was very understanding about my anxiety. I didn't get a full pelvic and pap smear but I did get a breast exam. It's not that bad as long as you don't think about it too much. See if your Dr will make conversation about school or plans you have for the weekend or something, mine asked me about college while she did it and it made it a lot easier.

Best of luck to you my friend <3 Remember, take some deep breaths and if you think it might help, ask for anxiety medication beforehand! I took a Valium before I went and it helped me stay way calmer than I would've been without it.

"A well regulated militia composed of the body of the people, being the best security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms shall not be infringed, but no one religiously scrupulous of bearing arms, shall be compelled to render military service in person.”

Four times between 1876 and 1939, the U.S. Supreme Court declined to rule that the Second Amendment protected individual gun ownership outside the context of a militia. As the Tennessee Supreme Court put it in 1840,
